2026-10-08.title_zh: 美财政部就违反对外投资计划开出首例民事处罚
2026-10-08.summary: In July 2026, the U.S. Department of the Treasury issued its first civil penalty under the Outbound Investment Security Program (OISP). Treasury penalized Amidi, LLC $200,000 for failing to submit a required notification of an investment by its controlled foreign entity into a Chinese embodied artificial intelligence company. On April 19, 2025, Amidi's subsidiary, a Chinese fund, invested approximately $92,478 in Shanghai Qiongche Intelligent Technology Company Limited (Noematrix), a private Chinese company developing AI, robotics and embodied intelligence.
2026-10-08.summary_en: In July 2026, the U.S. Department of the Treasury issued its first civil penalty under the Outbound Investment Security Program (OISP). Treasury penalized Amidi, LLC $200,000 for failing to submit a required notification of an investment by its controlled foreign entity into a Chinese embodied artificial intelligence company. On April 19, 2025, Amidi's subsidiary, a Chinese fund, invested approximately $92,478 in Shanghai Qiongche Intelligent Technology Company Limited (Noematrix), a private Chinese company developing AI, robotics and embodied intelligence.
2026-10-08.summary_zh: 美国财政部宣布，已于2026年7月依据「对外投资安全计划」（OISP）开出首例民事处罚，对 Amidi, LLC 处以20万美元罚款，理由是其控制的境外实体对中国具身智能企业投资时未履行申报义务。2025年4月19日，该公司旗下中国基金向上海穹彻智能科技有限公司（Noematrix）投资约9.25万美元。OISP 自2025年1月2日生效，要求美国人士就对华（含港澳）人工智能、量子计算与半导体领域的特定投资进行通报，并禁止部分交易。财政部称国会2025年12月通过的 COINS 法案将进一步扩大该计划管辖范围。
